sources.title: Tiger Hill, Suzhou
sources.excerpt: Tiger Hill or Huqiu is a hill in Suzhou, China. It is a tourist destination that is known for its natural environment and historic sites. The hill's name is said to come from the fact it looks like a crouching tiger. Another legend states that a white tiger appeared on the hill to guard it following the burial of King Helü. The hill is also sometimes referred to in parallel with Shizishan, another mountain in Suzhou which resembles a sitting lion.
